title: ServiceLocation
description: A physical site a vehicle can be taken to: a depot, a holding yard, a garage site, an auction or a scrapyard. Modelled explicitly because the flow is often assumed to run from recovery straight to transport, while in practice there is frequently a stop in between, and that stop has its own handover and its own constraints. Held in the eVault of the organisation that operates the site.

canonicalOwnerEName.description: eName of the operating organisation eVault

operatorEName.description: eName of the organisation that operates the site

name.description: Name of the site as people know it

locationType.description: What kind of site this is

capacityFree.description: Vehicles the site can still take in now

opens.description: Opening time in local time, as HH:MM

closes.description: Closing time in local time, as HH:MM

openingHours.description: When the site is staffed, one entry per day it opens. A day with no entry is closed, unless twentyFourHourAccess is true.

twentyFourHourAccess.description: Whether vehicles can be dropped off at any hour

secured.description: Whether the site is fenced or guarded, so a vehicle and its contents are safe there

covered.description: Whether vehicles are kept indoors or under a roof

evCapable.description: Whether a damaged electric vehicle may be held here, which is a hard constraint rather than a preference

acceptsHazardous.description: Whether vehicles with a hazardous load or a fluid leak may be held here

contactEName.description: eName of the person to contact about the site

status.description: active while the site takes vehicles. closed takes it out of destination choices.

createdAt.description: When the record was first written

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed

revision.description: Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every change to the record
